node.title: Re: CUPS Printing - Using a Variable as a Filename
node.author: Fletch
node.doctext:
Reading the perldoc printFile says it takes a filename not a filehandle: "You must provide the name of the file and a title for the job."

You might could use [mod://File::Temp] (possibly after setting $ENV{TMPDIR} to something like /dev/shm depending on the OS) and write there, then pass that path to printFile.

The cake is a lie.
